context.stage: WF-03 FAST-TRACK — fix client protocol-mapper URL

task.description:
WF-03 FAST-TRACK: Fix the protocol mapper URL in provider.zig.

Root cause: Steps 9, 10, 11 in provisionRealm/provisionClient use `keycloak_urls.protocolMappersCollection(allocator, config, realm_id)` which generates `/admin/realms/{realm}/protocol-mappers/models`. This is the REALM-LEVEL mapper endpoint — it returns 404 for mapper creation via this path. Protocol mappers for a specific client must go to the CLIENT-LEVEL endpoint: `/admin/realms/{realm}/clients/{clientUuid}/protocol-mappers/models`.

Fix in src/identity/provider/adapters/keycloak/urls.zig:
Add a new function: clientProtocolMappersCollection that takes realm_id AND client_uuid:
  `/admin/realms/{realm}/clients/{client_uuid}/protocol-mappers/models`

Fix in src/identity/provider/adapters/keycloak/provider.zig:
In provisionRealm (where Steps 9/10/11 post the mappers), change the URL from:
  keycloak_urls.protocolMappersCollection(allocator, config, realm_id)
to:
  keycloak_urls.clientProtocolMappersCollection(allocator, config, realm_id, client_uuid)
where client_uuid is the UUID returned from the createClient step (the client's internal Keycloak UUID, different from clientId='bpm-platform-api').

Note: the client UUID comes from the Location header or response body when the client is created. Read how provisionRealm or provisionClient currently obtains the client UUID after creation. If it's not captured, add code to GET /admin/realms/{realm}/clients?clientId=bpm-platform-api and read [0].id to get the UUID.

Steps that need updating:
- Step 9: tenant_id protocol mapper (OIDC-13) — from PR #109
- Step 10: realm-roles mapper — from PR #112
- Step 11: audience mapper — from PR #113
All three must use the client-level URL.

Branch: feature/WF03-client-mapper-url-20260616
